fields.agentId: target agent id; defaults to surfaced/failed agent in UI only when missing from plain waypoint-list imports
fields.waypoints: future waypoint list to replace or append
fields.planner: planner metadata with usesForecast, usesTruth, usesOracle

notes: Used for surfacing and route-failure recovery imports. The browser validates waypoints before applying and defaults to replacing future waypoints after current simulation time.
